title: Claude Opus 4.7: Frontier Coding (2026)
hook: Claude Opus 4.7's gains land hardest on the hardest software-engineering tasks, and it now checks its own work - better self-verification of its outputs alongside the coding boost.
key_points: Generally available; a notable improvement over Opus 4.6 in advanced software engineering, with the largest gains on the hardest tasks.
Improved instruction-following and better self-verification of its own outputs.
Vision now accepts images up to 2,576 px on the long edge, about 3.75 megapixels - over 3x prior Claude models.
Available across Claude products, the API (model id claude-opus-4-7), Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, and Microsoft Foundry.
content_html: Anthropic made Claude Opus 4.7 generally available in April 2026, an iteration on its frontier line with a notable improvement over Opus 4.6 in advanced software engineering - and the largest gains showing up on the hardest tasks.
extra_html:
What's new

Beyond the coding boost, Opus 4.7 brings improved instruction-following and better self-verification, meaning the model is more able to check its own outputs. Its vision input grew too: it now accepts images up to 2,576 pixels on the long edge, about 3.75 megapixels, more than 3x the limit of prior Claude models.

Why it matters

Concentrating improvement on the hardest engineering tasks, plus better self-verification, targets exactly where coding assistants tend to fail - long, gnarly problems where a wrong answer goes unnoticed. Opus 4.7 is available across Claude products, the API as model id claude-opus-4-7, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, and Microsoft Foundry. See Anthropic's announcement for details.

related.title: Claude 4: Opus 4 and Sonnet 4
related.hook: Claude 4 lets a model interleave reasoning with tool calls - thinking, calling a tool, thinking again, and even running tools in parallel - rather than reasoning once and answering.

related.title: OpenAI o3: Reasoning that Uses Tools
related.hook: o3 is the first reasoning model that can agentically reach for every ChatGPT tool mid-thought - web search, Python on your files, image input, image generation - and combine them to solve a problem.
